strength: The Fog knob now brings 2p Honest/Greedy into band (56/58, was 73/82) with a 54.7-point skill gap and a code attack that no longer pays (+1.0 at F8, +3.0 at F12); the double-lamp Offer is novel and cheap to make.
weakness: Middle-game pacing: Trim is 30% of turns (target <25%) and 3+ Trim runs occur in 61% of 2p games (target <10%), 60% forced by the Offer legality rule; also Beacon-blind ablation fails (0.5/0.9, a flat time gift) and 3p is out of band with Greedy +9.4 over Honest. Repeats L3 (flat decided-by-luck stretch), L8 (3p) and L1 (inert Beacon).
required_changes: Loosen Offer legality or allow Offer after Trim so Trim stops being forced: Trim share <25% of turns, 3+ Trim runs <10% of games; re-run Code attack at F8 and F12 (<= Honest +10) and keep 2p in 40-60%
Make Beacon a real decision or cut it: Beacon-blind must lose >=5 points, or remove it and reconfirm the 2p band
Set 3p Standard F=6 and re-test (both bots 40-60, Greedy minus Honest <=5) or label 3p a variant
Update rules.md Known gaps and 7.3/7.6 text to measured results without growing the line count (L7)
Summarise close-game shares (late wins, near-losses) in the playtest report
revision_reason: Yes, one more cycle: problems are mechanical (legality threshold, Beacon, 3p Fog), 2p is in band; target Trim share <25% and 3+ Trim runs <10% with Code attack still <= Honest +10. If Trim does not fall under 25%, stop and go to a human playtest.
